duration.text: The Pharmacy at Shandong University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Application Form PassportHealth Examination CertificateHighest Education Degree CertificateTranscript Certificate of No Criminal RecordLanguage CertificateStudy Plan

requirements.text: 1. The applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen (in accordance with the relevant requirements of the "Notice of the Ministry of Education on Regulating the Work of Higher Education Institutions in Accepting International Students"), in good health, friendly towards China, and have no criminal record.2. The applicant must hold a master's degree.3. Language proficiency requirements:(1) For Chinese-taught programs: HSK Level 5 (180 points or above) or higher certificate; for applicants whose highest degree is taught in Chinese, the HSK certificate is not required, but proof of teaching language must be provided.(2) For English-taught programs: Applicants whose native language is English do not need to provide English language proof; applicants whose native language is not English must provide IELTS (6.0 or above), TOEFL (80 points or above), TOEFL iBT (80 or above), Essentials Test (8 points or above), or other equivalent English proficiency proof materials; applicants whose native language is not English and whose highest degree is taught in English do not need to provide IELTS/TOEFL etc. English proficiency proof, but must submit proof of teaching language.
